Key points
• The term “fatty acid” comprises a large group of biologically and structurally diverse molecules. The metabolism of these
compounds is equally diverse.
• Fatty acids can be structural components of more complex lipids, including triacylglycerol and phospholipids. They can be
degraded for energy production; conversely, fatty acids can be synthesized from carbohydrates for energy storage. Poly-
